name: @tria/boundary-fixture
description: MOD-02 NEGATIVE FIXTURE — a module-tagged package that breaks every boundary on purpose. It must FAIL `turbo boundaries` and Biome; `pnpm boundaries:negative` (scripts/check-boundaries.sh) asserts exactly that. `@tria/module-example` is imported but deliberately NOT declared as a dependency, so the violation is also an undeclared import — the truthful shape of reaching into another module's internals, since that path was never published in its `exports`. It declares no lint/typecheck/build/test script, so `turbo run …` never picks it up.
